name: Hindustan Construction Company Limited
summary: Hindustan Construction Company Limited provides engineering and construction services in India and internationally. The company constructs roads, highways, expressways, bridges, elevated corridors, railways, metro rails, ports, and marine structures; dams, barrages, tunnels, powerhouses, shafts, and various underground works; and reactors, auxiliary buildings, spent fuel buildings, safety pump houses, and control buildings. It also constructs integrated water supply systems, bulk water transmission and irrigation projects, water treatment and sewage treatment plants, and aqueducts; hydrocarbon, and metals and process plants and factories; and residential and commercial buildings, institution…
